# Easyflint   [![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?labelColor=black&color=grey&label=&suffix=%20downloads&query=downloads&url=https://api.modrinth.com/v2/project/ZULGshGp&style=for-the-badge&logo=data:image/png;base64,)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/easyflint)

Download Easyflint and make dropping gravel onto torches a thing of the past. 
<br/>This data pack lets you craft 1 gravel into 1 flint. 

I went looking for a pack like this and didn't find one that didn't mess with the 1:1 ratio, so I just made my own. 

Easyflint is very lightweight in size. It's essentially just the recipe and the hidden advancement that makes it show up in the recipe book. 

No need to unzip the file or anything; just drop it right into the `datapacks` folder for your world or server, and you're good to go! If you're using the mod rather than the datapack, place it in your `mods` folder instead. 
<br/>You can also easily install/update Easyflint using a launcher like PrismLauncher or Modrinth App.

Have fun!
<br/>-kk iris

---

This project is also an example use-case for [liquid-build](https://github.com/kkiris/liquid-build), a tool for rendering Liquid templates & creating packages with shared files/variables.
